shots.what: hook, aerial: a huge circle of Siberian taiga with every tree knocked flat and pointing outward, a ring of standing forest at the edge, smoke and low mist; hook card 'No Crater'
dawn, 30 June 1908: Evenk reindeer herders' tents (chums) and reindeer by the Podkamennaya Tunguska River; a blinding fireball streaks across the sky and they look up; card 'Siberia, 1908'

a log-cabin trading post (Vanavara) at the forest edge: a bright flash on the horizon, then a wave of wind - shutters bang, windows burst outward as glass shards, people stumble and fall, birds scatter; no injuries shown; card 'Windows Shattered'
1927: scientist Leonid Kulik (beard, cap, coat) and two helpers with packs walk through mile after mile of fallen trunks, all pointing the same way away from the centre; card 'All Pointing Out'
the centre of the blast: bare upright trunks stripped of branches like telegraph poles, young green regrowth below, Kulik looking up at them; card 'Still Standing'
